protocol.excluded: old reps 24..31 never enter this experiment
protocol.target: each relative opponent played a combination family in immediately previous round; public actions only
protocol.selection: validation balanced BCE, every 200 steps including zero; select rate per seed; seal before test evaluation
protocol.head_control: same original reader, fixed initial train standardizer and 128->64->12 head; replace only ReLU by LeakyReLU(0.1)
protocol.query_control: 12 slots in every arm, common 140->64 LeakyReLU->1 question head; Q/K per-head LayerNorm in all six arms

queries.actual: original private query repeated for all questions
queries.centered: train-only global featurewise standardized private query repeated
queries.task: 24 trainable public target-seat x family queries, initialized N(0,1); no answer input

protocol.mask: all valid tokens or explicit previous-round target-opponent Play tokens; public seat/round/phase only
protocol.pool_control: same parameter count and initial weights: 128->64 LeakyReLU->128 phi before/after masked mean; early max separately
protocol.pool_supervision: only 12 match-level binary facts, no per-token type supervision
protocol.stable_head: training-batch feature normalization, recalibrated on all 800 training matches at each checkpoint; no heldout statistics
protocol.inference: 5000 stratified paired seed-cluster bootstraps; three optimizer seeds averaged, not counted as matches; 95% descriptive and familywise 99.444% contrast intervals
protocol.scope: CPU only, <=4 processes x 1 torch thread, isolated learned readers/heads; frozen encoder/private query; no PPO or mainline writes
protocol.limitations: dense public fact retrieval, not strength or strategic adaptation; task queries/masks grant explicit question/address information

mechanism-audit.donor_control_limitation: descriptive; donor facts aligned to rotated input, weighted by receiver type; not independent seed-cluster inference
